#!/bin/bash

function example_function {
  if [ "$#" -lt "1" ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 arg1 [-v] [--optional_arg arg2]"
    return
  fi
  local arg2=$3 # $3 contains the optional argument as it is passed with $#

  case $2 in
    -v|--verbose)
      set +x  # Enable xtrace debugging for verbose flag
      ;;
    --optional_arg=*)
      arg2=${arg2#*=} # Remove any existing value before assigning to variable
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown option: $2"
      ;;
  esac

  if [ -z $arg2 ]; then
    echo "No optional argument passed, defaulting to 'default'"
    arg2="default"
  fi

  echo "Usage: $0 arg1 [-v] [--optional_arg]"
  ( # Enclose commands in parentheses for local scope
    set -- "$@" -v   # Enable verbose flag output
  )

  option_args=("--optional_arg")
  
  _example_complete() { # Custom completer function
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -$1 ${cscope} ${options[@]}))
  }

  if [ -z $arg2 ]; then
    complete -F _example_complete --option_args "${command[@]}"       # Show list of available options including optional argument
  else
    complete -F _example_complete --option_arg="${arg2}" "${command[@]}"
  fi

  shift ${#option_args[@]} # Shift positional parameters for option parsing
}

# Define bash completion functions for both the main command and the verbose flag
complete -F __complete _example_function "example_function"
complete -F __complete _example_function "" "-v --verbose example_function"

setup_example_complete() {  
  function __example_finalize_completion {
    # This is an additional helper function that finalizes the completion setup,

  function __example_complete_flags {
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "${flags[*]}" -- ${cscope}))
  }

  complete -F __example_complete_flags "${command[@]}"
}

setup_example_complete  # Initialize the final completion setup
